abstract: Food taxation is increasingly proposed to improve diets, reduce health risks, and lower greenhouse gas emissions, yet equity concerns limit implementation. This study compares value-added tax reform, carbon taxation, sugar and saturated-fat taxes, a coronary heart disease risk tax, and universal and targeted food subsidies in Ireland. Using household microdata linked to nutrient and emissions data, it combines distributional characteristics, inequality measures, and microsimulation to examine how alternative food tax bases affect households across the income distribution. Baseline simulations estimate first-round financial incidence under full pass-through and fixed pre-policy quantities; a conditional Linear Expenditure System sensitivity analysis allows food-at-home purchases to respond to own-price changes. Higher-income households consume more nutrients and generate more food-related emissions in absolute terms, while saturated fat is concentrated in lower-income food baskets. All simulated taxes are financially regressive, but their source and scale differ: carbon taxation generates the largest increase in inequality, whereas sugar and saturated-fat taxes are more regressive in relative-incidence terms. Targeted subsidies partly offset regressivity. Behavioural adjustment moderates tax payments but does not alter the underlying distributional pattern.
abstract_zh: 食品税日益被提议用于改善膳食、降低健康风险和减少温室气体排放，但公平性担忧限制了其实施。本研究比较了爱尔兰的增值税改革、碳税、糖税和饱和脂肪税、冠心病风险税以及普惠性和定向性食品补贴。研究使用与营养素和排放数据相关联的家庭微观数据，结合分布特征、不平等测度和微观模拟，考察替代性食品税基如何影响不同收入分布中的家庭。基准模拟在完全转嫁和固定政策前数量的假设下估计第一轮财务归宿；条件性线性支出系统敏感性分析允许家庭内食品购买对自身价格变化作出反应。高收入家庭在绝对量上消费更多营养素并产生更多与食品相关的排放，而饱和脂肪集中于低收入家庭的食品篮子。所有模拟税收在财务上均具有累退性，但其来源和规模不同：碳税导致不平等增幅最大，而糖税和饱和脂肪税在相对归宿意义上更具累退性。定向补贴部分抵消了累退性。行为调整缓和了税款支付，但未改变潜在的分布格局。
title: Distributional characteristics of fiscal measures for food system transformation: food security, health and climate implications
title_zh: 粮食系统转型财政措施的分配特征：粮食安全、健康与气候影响

abstract: In public discourse on fiscal tensions across OECD countries, the potential contribution of higher economic growth tends to be overstated. This column argues that long-run fiscal sustainability cannot prudently rely on growth alone. OECD modelling shows that under current policy settings, productivity-led growth provides minimal fiscal relief due to wage linkages, benefit indexation, and relative price effects. Growth from rising labour utilisation is fiscally more potent, but restraining public expenditure is the surest path to long-run fiscal sustainability.
abstract_zh: 在关于经合组织国家财政紧张的公共讨论中，经济更快增长可能带来的贡献往往被夸大。本专栏认为，长期财政可持续性不能审慎地仅依赖增长。经合组织的模型显示，在当前政策设定下，由生产率驱动的增长由于工资联动、福利指数化和相对价格效应，所能提供的财政缓解极为有限。由劳动利用率上升带来的增长在财政上更为有效，但抑制公共支出才是实现长期财政可持续性最可靠的路径。
title: Growth alone is an unlikely fiscal saviour; resolving long-run fiscal tensions in OECD countries also requires expenditure restraint
title_zh: 仅靠增长难以成为财政救星；解决经合组织国家的长期财政紧张还需限制支出

abstract: Giannone et al (2026) show that aging and depopulation will lead to concentration of people in large cities such as Tokyo, while leaving old prefectures to shrink. When local public goods provision entails fixed costs, a shrinking and aging population in small localities presents a new challenge for financing these goods. I describe the financing of such goods across countries, and then discuss two avenues for future research building on their framework. First, in many countries, a major part of local taxes falls on property values, which jump once the decline becomes clear and so can decline faster than the need for local public goods. This raises the question of how local and national governments can maintain equitable access to local public goods when local property values fall before population. Second, the rapid decline necessitates national transfers, but such policies are set by elected national and local governments. Understanding how the incentives of national and local electorates evolve with aging, how they interact and how local age structures are shaped by policies is also important. Both questions are relevant for many advanced economies, where aging and depopulation are under way.
abstract_zh: Giannone等人（2026）的研究表明，人口老龄化与人口减少将导致人口向东京等大城市集中，而老旧县区则逐渐萎缩。当地方公共品的供给涉及固定成本时，小地区人口萎缩与老龄化给这类公共品的融资带来了新挑战。我描述了各国此类公共品的融资方式，然后基于他们的框架探讨了两个未来研究方向。第一，在许多国家，地方税收的很大一部分落在房产价值上，而一旦衰退趋势明朗，房产价值便会骤降，因此其下降速度可能快于对地方公共品的需求。这引出了一个问题：当地方房产价值先于人口下降时，地方和国家政府如何维持地方公共品的公平可及性。第二，人口的快速下降 necessitate 国家转移支付，但此类政策由民选的国家和地方政府制定。理解国家和地方选民的激励如何随老龄化演变、它们如何相互作用以及地方年龄结构如何被政策塑造，同样至关重要。这两个问题对许多正在经历老龄化和人口减少的发达经济体都具有相关性。
title: Who pays for a ghost town? Local public finance and the geography of aging
title_zh: 谁为鬼城买单？地方公共财政与老龄化地理
